bitmap-overview-desc: We create new value at the intersection of technology and art.\nJoin us on a journey to turn creators' imaginations into reality.
what-is-bitmap: Bitmap is a versatile team focused on video producers, 3D motion graphics and animation creators, music producers, and developers.
our-portfolio: From video to development, Bitmap is a versatile collaboration of experts across fields. Discover Bitmap's unique portfolio born from the fusion of 3D animation, sound design, and code.
start-of-bitmap: At the end of 2017, three video producers (BuIuD, Mat, Platina) planned and formed the team in July 16, 2018.
origin-of-name: The origin of the team name comes from when BuIuD, Mat, and Platina were planning the team. Mat suggested MBP (a derivative of MVP), but Platina proposed BMP (the extension for bitmap graphic files), which was accepted.
start-with-bitmap: Start creating something new with Bitmap right now.
